note: notifySnapshot now polls at elapsed >= interval - one snapshot tick and waits for the mutex instead of TryLock-dropping. TestSFlowV5CounterGapNeverExceedsInterval drives 30 late 1.01 s snapshots at a 5 s interval through a real Sender and requires no gap over 5 s and at least 6 polls; the old elapsed >= interval gate leaves a 5.05 s gap and goes red (author observed red at HEAD). Its two tags sit on one assertion: the maximum is one upper bound, so this is effectively single-polarity, not a pair. TestSFlowCounterPollAtInterval covers the 1 s interval. The busy-exporter drop is covered under x-26.
